description: Replace the cues of a finished transcription (from transcribe or caption_video) with corrected text or timing, without transcribing again. Free; needs the key that owns the job. Pass cues [{start, end, text}] in seconds or subtitles (SRT, VTT or JSON); the old cues are overwritten. A later burn_captions, translate or remove_silences with this transcriptionJobId uses the edited cues and pays only its own step. To fix spellings for every future job use update_glossary {action:'save'} instead. Returns the job with the new SRT, VTT and JSON URLs.

cues.description: Corrected cues [{start, end, text}] with start/end in seconds. Pass this or subtitles.

jobId.description: Id of the finished transcribe or caption_video job whose cues to replace.

subtitles.description: Corrected captions as SRT, WebVTT or JSON. Pass this or cues.

name: edit_transcript

outputSchema.description: A job: poll get_job with id until status is succeeded or failed.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed.

expiresAt.description: When the result files are deleted.

id.description: Job id: pass it to get_job, resume_job, edit_transcript or as transcriptionJobId.

kind.description: Job kind (transcribe, burn, caption, clips, shorts, trim, dub, translate, preview, metadata...).

result.description: Result when succeeded: url, files[{name, url}], clips, text...

title: Edit transcript
